# GET /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/signing-key.pub

Returns the SSH signing key for a given repository

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-007`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |

## Response

**200** — text/plain

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `body` | string | SSH public key |

- **404** — No signing key configured or format is not ssh
- **500** — Error reading SSH key file

## Workflow

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | misc.SigningKeySSH | controller | Call getSigningKey with format=ssh |
| 2 | [services](../modules/services.md) | asymkey_service.PublicSigningKey | service | Call git.GetSigningKey; Read SSH key file |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Signing key format must match expected format (openpgp or ssh), otherwise 404 | business_logic | format != expectedFormat |
| If signing key is 'none', no key is returned | business_logic | setting.Repository.Signing.SigningKey == "none" |
| If signing key is 'default', reads git global config to determine key | business_logic | setting.Repository.Signing.SigningKey == "default" || == "" |

### Error Paths

- **No signing key configured** → ctx.APIErrorNotFound → 404
- **Key format mismatch** → ctx.APIErrorNotFound → 404
- **File read error** → ctx.APIErrorInternal → 500
